s: Look at the picture. The mother duck is 　　　 the baby ducks across the street. 【108年會考】
e: 根據圖片，母鴨正在帶領著小鴨過馬路，故選(Ｂ)。

s: Ms. Liu usually gives us a lot of homework, 　　　 she didn’t give us any today. 【108年會考】
e: 前後句語意轉折，所以選「但是」。

s: Diane had a bad cold last week.  She is still too 　　　 to go mountain climbing with you. 【108年會考】
e: 因為上禮拜重感冒，現在身體還沒完全康復，所以是「虛弱的」。

s: Last night a garbage truck hit a tree and turned over.  Now the street is 　　　 with lots of garbage. 【108年會考】
e: 因為是垃圾車翻覆，街上到處是垃圾，所以很「髒亂」。

s: Joyce tells her brother everything.  She never 　　　 anything from him. 【108年會考】
e: 前面一句說　Joyce　所有事情都會跟她哥哥說，代表她不會「隱瞞」事情。

s: Ben always uses his birthday as a(n) 　　　 to ask Dad to buy him something expensive. 【108年會考】
e: 根據題意，只有(Ｂ)符合題幹文意，故正確答案為選項(Ｂ)，其他選項代入後均不合文意。

s: Everyone in the class enjoys playing chess 　　　 Bill; he thinks the game is boring. 【108年會考】
e: 由　he（＝Bill）thinks the game is boring　可知「除了」他，班上人人都喜歡玩西洋棋，故正確答案為選項(Ａ)。

s: Tom’s voice 　　　 when he talks about his neighbors.  He speaks faster, his face becomes redder and you can almost see fire in his eyes. 【108年會考】
e: 根據文意，Tom　談及鄰居時，話說得很快、臉脹紅，而且眼睛冒火，可推知　Tom　很生氣，音量應該會「提高」，故正確答案為選項(Ｄ)。其他選項代入後均不合文意。

s: Playing games on the cellphone 　　　 popular with high school students. 【108年會考】
e: 此題要選擇主要動詞，而主詞是「Playing games on the cellphone」這一件事情，所以動詞選單數的　is，(Ｃ)(Ｄ)選項都不能當作動詞使用。

s: There 　　　 more than twenty clubs in our school.  Which one would you like to join? 【108年會考】
e: 此句型是「我們學校有」，所以要用　There is / are　句型，(Ａ)(Ｂ)選項必須以人當主詞。主詞「超過二十個社團」是複數，所以要用　are。

s: The book under Mary’s desk is 　　　, but I don’t know why it is there. 【108年會考】
e: 這裡的　mine＝my book，由語意知道桌子底下的書是我的書，所以用　mine　代替　my book，不能選(Ｃ)選項的　my　是因為選項沒有　book。

s: It almost killed Kevin to take care of his baby sister for one afternoon.  He wondered how his mom could do 　　　 every day. 【108年會考】
e: Kevin　困惑他媽媽怎麼有辦法每天都做照顧他妹妹「這一件事情」，這一件事情用　it　代替。

s: that last piece of pie?  If not, can I have it?  I didn’t eat much this morning. 【108年會考】
e: 根據文意，I didn’t eat much this morning. 表示「過去」沒有吃太多東西，所以說話者詢問對方「將會吃」那最後一塊派嗎？如果對方不吃，可以給他吃嗎？故正確答案為未來式的選項(Ｄ)。

s: In my school days, I 　　　 to English radio programs every day.  That was how I learned English at that time. 【108年會考】
e: 由　In my school days　與　That was how I learned English at that time.可知時態是過去式，表示過去「習慣聽」英文廣播節目，故正確答案為選項(Ｃ)。選項(Ｄ)代表那時候「正在聽」，但題目的時間是　In my school days　並不是過去明確的幾點幾分，所以不能用過去進行式。

s: other waiters in the restaurant have worked here longer than Clark; only Lois and Lana started working here before him. 【108年會考】
e: 由　Only Lois and Lana started working here before him（＝Clark）. 此句中　only　與　before　兩個關鍵字可推知只有「少數」服務生在這間餐廳工作的時間比　Clark　長，故正確答案為選項(Ｄ)。

s: (１)　What are “Daddy and me” doing in the poem?
p:
Making goulash
we don’t talk much,
Daddy and me.
“The talking’s in the making, son,”
he smiles.
I see what he means.
It’s in the knife
meeting the beef,
in the dancing of potatoes
as they turn in the water,
in the singing
of boiling soup in the pot.
There are enough words
in the way
Daddy teaches me his famous dish
and the way he hugs me
when we finish.
Making goulash
we don’t talk much,
Daddy and me,
but everything is said.
(Ideas from Candace Pearson’s poem)

【108年會考】
e: 從第一句　making goulash　可以得知，文中提到兩人一起烹煮食物，答案為選項(Ｄ)。

s: (２)　What can we most likely（可能）know about the speaker?
p:
Making goulash
we don’t talk much,
Daddy and me.
“The talking’s in the making, son,”
he smiles.
I see what he means.
It’s in the knife
meeting the beef,
in the dancing of potatoes
as they turn in the water,
in the singing
of boiling soup in the pot.
There are enough words
in the way
Daddy teaches me his famous dish
and the way he hugs me
when we finish.
Making goulash
we don’t talk much,
Daddy and me,
but everything is said.
(Ideas from Candace Pearson’s poem)

【108年會考】
o: He enjoys his time with his father.
He often makes goulash for his father.
He wants to be as famous as his father.
e: 從最後一段中，可以看到雖然他們過程中不太說話，但一切盡在不言中，代表說話者非常享受與爸爸一起烹煮食物的過程，故答案選(Ｂ)。

s: (１)　Which is true about City Sight Bus tickets?
o: It costs less to buy tickets on the Internet.
People must pay the full ticket price for a pet.
Tickets are more expensive in the high season.
People save 10% if they buy two tickets for the same line.
e: 從　Save 10% if you buy tickets on the Internet. 可得知(Ａ)為正解。從　Save 10% if you buy tickets for both lines. 得知需同時購買兩種路線的車票才可以享九折優惠，故不能選(Ｄ)。

s: (２)　Which is true about the bus lines?
o: Both lines leave from Central Station.
There are more gardens to see on Line A.
e: 根據圖片及注意事項的第一點，正解為(Ｃ)。

s: (１)　Why were there seventeen calls asking for Mike?
p:
Sarah: You’re VERY popular today. I’ve had seventeen calls asking for you.
Mike: Finally! After all these years of kicking and running, I’ve got my own fans! So what did they want? My photos? Do I need to sign my name? Are they starting a fan club for me?
Sarah: Well, let me ask you this: What day was yesterday?
Mike: Friday... Why?
Sarah: Did you forget something?
Mike: Did I forget... OH, NO! I didn’t pick up my soccer team’s sport shirts from the shop! And we’re having this big game tomorrow!
Sarah: Yeah. And from what I’ve heard, it’s your team’s most important game this season.
Mike: OK. I have to go fix this now.
Sarah: Too late. They’ve tried. It’s not open on the weekend. And if you want to know, they are Johnny, Ricky, Archie, Freddie...
Mike: I know, I know, everyone on my team. Oh, I’m a dead man now.
Sarah: Yeah, that was what they said on the phone, seventeen times.
【108年會考】
o: His team was angry at him.
He is a popular soccer player.
He did not show up for the game on Friday.
His name did not appear on the list of players.
e: 看到最後兩句可以得知，Mike　說　I’m a dead man.接著　Sarah　說其他十七個球員也說他死定了，故(Ａ)為正解。

s: (２)　What does It mean in the dialogue?
p:
Sarah: You’re VERY popular today. I’ve had seventeen calls asking for you.
Mike: Finally! After all these years of kicking and running, I’ve got my own fans! So what did they want? My photos? Do I need to sign my name? Are they starting a fan club for me?
Sarah: Well, let me ask you this: What day was yesterday?
Mike: Friday... Why?
Sarah: Did you forget something?
Mike: Did I forget... OH, NO! I didn’t pick up my soccer team’s sport shirts from the shop! And we’re having this big game tomorrow!
Sarah: Yeah. And from what I’ve heard, it’s your team’s most important game this season.
Mike: OK. I have to go fix this now.
Sarah: Too late. They’ve tried. It’s not open on the weekend. And if you want to know, they are Johnny, Ricky, Archie, Freddie...
Mike: I know, I know, everyone on my team. Oh, I’m a dead man now.
Sarah: Yeah, that was what they said on the phone, seventeen times.
【108年會考】
e: 從句子可以得知，週末沒有營業的只可能是店家，故選(Ａ)。

s: (３)　What can we learn about Mike?
p:
Sarah: You’re VERY popular today. I’ve had seventeen calls asking for you.
Mike: Finally! After all these years of kicking and running, I’ve got my own fans! So what did they want? My photos? Do I need to sign my name? Are they starting a fan club for me?
Sarah: Well, let me ask you this: What day was yesterday?
Mike: Friday... Why?
Sarah: Did you forget something?
Mike: Did I forget... OH, NO! I didn’t pick up my soccer team’s sport shirts from the shop! And we’re having this big game tomorrow!
Sarah: Yeah. And from what I’ve heard, it’s your team’s most important game this season.
Mike: OK. I have to go fix this now.
Sarah: Too late. They’ve tried. It’s not open on the weekend. And if you want to know, they are Johnny, Ricky, Archie, Freddie...
Mike: I know, I know, everyone on my team. Oh, I’m a dead man now.
Sarah: Yeah, that was what they said on the phone, seventeen times.
【108年會考】
o: He is nice to people from his fan club.
He plays soccer with Johnny and Ricky.
He found a way to fix the trouble he made.
He decided not to go to the game on Sunday.
e: 從 “if you want to know, they are Johnny, Ricky, Archie, Freddie...” 得知，他們都打電話來找　Mike，代表他們一起踢球，故答案為(Ｂ)。

s: (１)　Which is the best title（標題）for this reading?
p: 【108年會考】
o: Australia: The Best Place for Birds.
Larger Mother Birds Have Larger Eggs.
Family Love: Brothers & Sisters Work Together.
e: 文中提到了母鳥因應不同氣候會產下不同大小的卵，以協助幼鳥在氣候的變遷下存活，所以(Ｂ)是正解。

s: (２)　What does this trick mean in the reading?
p: 【108年會考】
o: Saving food for weaker baby birds.
Helping baby birds break out of the eggs.
e: 第一段先提及母鳥因應不同天氣會產下不同的卵，而後第二段中提到了　not all mother birds are able to do this trick，其中母鳥是關鍵字，所以(Ａ)是正解。

s: (３)　What can we learn about superb fairy-wrens from the reading?
p: 【108年會考】
o: Male birds can usually live for ten years.
Baby birds grow well in hot, dry weather.
Young male birds share the job of feeding the baby birds.
Mother birds make smaller eggs when there is less food outside.
e: 第二段有提及公幼鳥分擔了撫育幼鳥的工作，所以(Ｃ)是正解。

s: (１)　What idea is talked about in both pieces of news?
p:
Here are two pieces of news that Annie collected for her report.


【108年會考】
o: More young people need to join in making art.
People’s ways of enjoying art change with time.
Bringing important art works to Taiwan from abroad.
Giving new life to old arts that were almost forgotten.
e: 根據新聞一的第四行開始，及新聞二的第一行開始，皆是闡述因為人們的努力創新及改革，使得老藝術得到重新認識及欣賞，所以此題答案為(Ｄ)。

s: (２)　What does it mean when something is a smash hit?
p:
Here are two pieces of news that Annie collected for her report.


【108年會考】
e: 根據第二則新聞的第五行到第八行，「人們對相聲重燃興趣」、「賴聲川打開相聲市場大門」及「愛好者遍布各年齡層」來看，表示賴聲川讓相聲這種老藝術成功地流行起來，故答案選(Ｂ)。

s: (３)　What do we know from the news?
p:
Here are two pieces of news that Annie collected for her report.


【108年會考】
o: Lai has taught xiangsheng in many schools.
Lai often puts his own life stories into his art works.
The owner of Hsin Hsin Paper Offering Store is a Frenchman.
People do not burn papier-mâché for dead people as often as before.
e: (Ａ)(Ｂ)選項在新聞二中皆沒有提到。(Ｃ)選項在第一則新聞中我們可以了解店主為臺灣人。選項(Ｄ)根據第一則新聞的第三句及第四句中可得知，故此選項為正解。

s: (１)　Which idea is talked about in the news?
p: 【108年會考】
o: How often we should drink coffee.
What happens when we have too much coffee.
How to help the body make the cortisol we need.
What happens when we have coffee at the wrong time.
e: 根據文章內容，第一段第三行提及，喝咖啡最糟的時間點就是起床後（It says the worst time for coffee is soon after we get up.）。並在同段倒數第四行說明產生的兩個問題（So there are two problems when we drink coffee during this time），因此答案為(Ｄ)。

s: (２)　What does it mean when someone thinks otherwise about something?
p: 【108年會考】
o: They have no idea about it.
They do not think it is a problem.
e: 根據文章內容，otherwise　前方提及，許多人起床後會來杯咖啡，但　otherwise　後方的報告卻說起床後喝咖啡是最糟的時間點，可推知　otherwise　是表示與前述看法不同的意見，故正確答案為選項(Ｃ)。

s: (３)　The picture below shows how the cortisol levels rise and fall during the day. From the news, which is a good time for coffee?
p: 【108年會考】
e: 根據文章，飲用咖啡最好的時段在早上八點到九點「之後」、正午到下午一點「之後」，或是下午五點半至六點半「之後」，選項(Ａ)(Ｂ)為皮質醇濃度正在上升之時，選項(Ｃ)為濃度最高、皆不是好的時間點，故(Ｄ)兩點半為正確答案。

s:
(４)　Four people read the news and wrote what they thought about it.

What did they think about the news?
p: 【108年會考】
o: They wanted to try what it said.
They were sad about what it said.
They did not agree with what it said.
They were not surprised at what it said.
e: Mike　表示自己想喝咖啡時就是喝咖啡最好的時間點，Sarah　說自己喝完咖啡才會清醒是「真正起床」，Charlie　說當自己沒電時才喝咖啡是最糟的時間點，Lisa　不同意要別人告知她喝咖啡的時間點，綜上所述，四人均不同意報導所言，故(Ｃ)為正確答案。

s: (１)　What does the report NOT suggest（建議）?
p:
Below is part of a new shopping center’s market report.


【108年會考】
o: Having more free buses for shoppers.
Changing the opening hours on weekdays.
Making plans to help weekday morning business.
Changing the time of the special sale on weekends.
e: 選項(Ａ)位於第一段倒數三行，選項(Ｂ)位於第二段倒數兩行，選項(Ｄ)位於第一段二～四行，故答案為(Ｃ)。

s: (２)　What does the report say about the shopping center?
p:
Below is part of a new shopping center’s market report.


【108年會考】
o: Its business on weekdays is not as good as last season.
It has a special sale one hour before closing every day.
Most of the shoppers take the free buses to the shopping center.
A large part of its shoppers on weekday evenings are working parents.
e: 於第二段第四行有提到週間晚上的消費族群，故答案為(Ｄ)。

s: (３)　Which picture is most likely（可能）used in the report?
p:
Below is part of a new shopping center’s market report.


【108年會考】
e: 從第一段知道生意最好的時段是週末下午，從第二段知道生意次好的是週末晚上，再來是平日晚上，最後是週末早上。

p:
克漏字測驗

【108年會考】
e: 根據空格後，文章的第一句及第二句，Maggie　想要變得像女演員們有大眼睛及纖細美腿，表示她想要改變她現在的模樣，故選擇答案(Ａ)。

p:
克漏字測驗

【108年會考】
o: you’re too shy to talk with people
you just don’t want to be like others
you don’t think you’re good enough
you don’t know what you’ve missed
e: 根據第二段第二句及第三句，我們得知　Linda　覺得　Maggie　並不愛自己，因此此題答案選(Ｃ)。

p: 【108年會考】
e: No one “thought”  “one day” 在當時沒人想過（過去式），有一天（未來），故(Ｄ)是正解。

p: 【108年會考】
e: “and he decided to marry her after he became the king.” 由　decided　判斷愛德華愛上美國女子的事實先發生，此處應選擇過去完成式，故(Ｃ)是正解。

p: 【108年會考】
o: It was not easy to give up the throne
It was good news to Elizabeth and her family
This part of history made the UK a strong country
e: 第一段先提及王位原應由國王愛德華八世繼承，但因國王愛德華八世的婚姻問題使他放棄王位，第二段提到此變故使伊莉莎白二世的父親繼位，也因此伊莉莎白的王位繼承權由此上升至第一位，由　She needed to say goodbye to her good old life and prepare to be a queen　足見這改變了伊莉莎白的一生，故(Ａ)是正解。

p: 【108年會考】
o: has worked hard for the UK
has been popular with the people of the UK
has been the queen of the UK for a long time
has brought the people of the UK much closer
e: 從第三段細數伊莉莎白二世的政績判斷，故(Ａ)是正解。從後面的　She has held meetings with important people in the UK, and has visited many foreign countries. 得知她為英國的奉獻，所以答案選(Ａ)。
